items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: And then Red Nichols came along at that time, and he worked at Roseland, he was a nice trumpet player. You know Red Nichols and his Five Pennies? They made a lot of records. I liked them both.

ctx.x: If you were to name a musician, trumpet player or other musician, who influenced you the most, who would you --

Who influenced me the most? Well, the one that I got most influence from was Louis, Louis Armstrong. Because Louis and I got very close. And he style was so different and everybody would listen to him. I didn't try to imitate him because nobody can do Louis. He was just Louis and that was all.
